name: @unbrowse/selenium-shim
description: Drop-in replacement for selenium-webdriver. driver.get() routes through Unbrowse's resolve+execute marketplace cache to serve getPageSource()/getTitle()/getCurrentUrl() from a synthesized response — same Builder/WebDriver/WebElement/By/until/Key surface, no WebDriver server or browser binary needed for cached reads.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm
